name: Honoring Your Husband
overview: Scripture calls wives to honor their husbands by submitting to them as to the Lord and showing them reverence, reflecting a Christ-centered relationship of respect and love. A virtuous woman is valued far above rubies, embodying character that fosters peace rather than contention, as Proverbs warns against a contentious spirit. Believers are urged to live worthy of their calling, grounded in sound doctrine, which includes honoring the marital roles established by God. This biblical teaching highlights the importance of reverence and submission within marriage as expressions of faithful Christian living.
